name: Kohinata Hayami
source:
Hayami is a girl in Takuma's class who sits next to him. She has an unsociable personality and a sharp attitude towards others, not wanting to become friends with others, due to her accepting her own status as an outcast. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/H2O:_Footprints_in_the_Sand]Wikipedia[/url]]
